description: This PHP class 'Sanitizer' provides functionality to sanitize SVG content to prevent security issues such as XSS. It leverages an external SVG sanitization library and throws a custom exception on failure.

classes.name: Sanitizer
classes.description: A utility class for sanitizing SVG content to ensure safety and validity.

methods.name: sanitizeSvg
methods.description: Sanitizes the given SVG content string. Throws an exception if the SVG content is malformed or cannot be sanitized.
